ThingDef.label: beam mining laser
ThingDef.description: A cutting laser that runs on power beams. It slices through the nearest rock or ore marked for mining that lies on one of its eight lines, within 30 tiles, and leaves the same yield a colonist would. The more power it receives, the faster it cuts: about one block every half minute at 1,000 W. In vacuum it cuts half again as fast.\n\nIt only asks for power while it has something to cut, so auto-aim sends beams to it when needed. Its cutting beam burns anyone who walks through it; a safety shutter on the line will pause it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam mining laser
ResearchProjectDef.description: Focus beam power into a cutting laser that mines rock and ore from a distance, building on deep-drilling know-how. Especially effective in the vacuum of space. Unlocks the beam mining laser.
